sections.#productTitle: Kate Naturals Organic Beet Root Powder for Smoothies, Baking & Juice, 8oz
sections.#feature-bullets: About this item ORGANIC BEET ROOT POWDER: Made from 100% pure beets, our beet root powder is USDA certified organic and non-GMO. This superfood powder is naturally rich in nutrients and antioxidants, making it a great addition to smoothies, juices, and recipes as part of a balanced diet. SUPPORTS NATURAL STAMINA AND ENERGY: Beetroot powder is a natural source of dietary nitrates that helps support active lifestyles. It is a popular beetroot preworkout option due to its natural nitrate content which is associated with the body's nitric oxide production. BEET ROOT POWDER FOR BAKING: This Beet Root Powder Organic can be added to your baked goods or sauces. Our red beet powder (remolacha en polvo) is a natural, vegan red food coloring alternative that can be used to give your cookies and cakes a beautiful red color. Organic beetroot powder can also be used for DIY recipes for hair, skin, soap making, color, and lip balm. EASY TO USE: Our beet juice powder is packed with nutrients and is easy to incorporate into your daily routine. Just add one teaspoon to your favorite beverage juice, or smoothie to get you through the day. We understand you have placed your trust in us to provide you with the best quality organic beets root powder. If you don't like this superfood, please let us know so we can make it right. Show more
